description: MustardSeedNetworks fleet-wide Renovate policy. Edit HERE, not in each repo. seed/stem/niac-go extend this via { "extends": ["github>MustardSeedNetworks/.github"] }. Policy is always-latest: updates are raised as soon as they exist, and everything below a major auto-merges once CI is green.

packageRules.description: Go toolchain, linter, and go.mod deps move together as one PR per repo.
The go directive + toolchain bump is security-sensitive; keep it its own PR.

Frontend toolchain (React, Vite, Vitest, Biome, Tailwind, TypeScript, types) as one PR. Both `typescript` and `@typescript/native-preview` are listed so the group keeps covering the compiler across the TS7 stable migration.
Pin GitHub Actions to SHAs and group their bumps.
Node and npm move together — the pin lives in each repo's setup-node composite action and the two must not drift apart.
Always-latest: patch, minor and digest bumps auto-merge once CI is green. CI is the gate — every repo runs the full ci.yml plus blocking zizmor and govulncheck, so a bad bump fails rather than lands.
Majors are raised immediately but never auto-merged — a breaking change needs a human to read the changelog. This is the one place the always-latest policy stops short.

customManagers.description: Go tools installed as `go install <module>@<version>` in Makefiles, mk/ fragments and workflows. Renovate's gomod manager only reads go.mod, so without this these pins are invisible to it — and an invisible pin is worse than a floating one, because it goes stale silently. Covers the security gates (govulncheck, gitleaks, staticcheck) among others.
